summary: MACD Divergence with RSI Filter strategy was fully designed, coded, and parameterized — all 3 required artifacts created on disk and syntax-validated (py_compile, JSON parse, YAML parse all pass). The WFA engine was never executed because the WSL agent environment lacks pandas/numpy, while the Windows .venv is the only environment that can run the WFA harness. The 5-year BTC dataset (43,789 bars) is confirmed present. This is the 4th experiment blocked by the same WSL/pandas environment gap. The experiment is preparation-only with zero performance metrics.

key_lessons.lesson: WSL/pandas blocker has now blocked 4 experiments: MACD Divergence, Volume Profile (EXP-20260318140000-01), RSI+Polymarket (EXP-20260317110000-01), and Volatility Regime (backlog). The factory cannot generate scored evidence while this gap persists.
key_lessons.specific_finding: All 4 experiments produced valid artifacts (strategy code, configs) but zero WFA metrics. The blocker is systematic, not isolated.

key_lessons.lesson: Divergence signals are rare on 1h BTC — the same low-trade-count risk that killed London Sweep (2 trades) and ATR Breakout (2 trades). A 10-parameter Optuna grid compounds this: 100 trials cannot adequately explore 10-D space.
key_lessons.specific_finding: WFA never ran, but pivot detection logic was verified on synthetic sine wave data. Whether 43,789 hourly bars produce enough divergence signals to avoid the 2-6 trade failure mode is unknown.
key_lessons.contradicts_prior: Extends the pattern from ATR Breakout and London Sweep: complex strategies with rare signals on 1h fail to produce statistically meaningful trade counts.

key_lessons.lesson: MACD divergence is a genuinely novel signal class — price-vs-momentum divergence vs price-based RSI/SMA/BB and volatility-based BB Width/ATR Regime. Strategy code and config architecture follow established patterns correctly.
key_lessons.specific_finding: Strategy design is sound: hidden bullish divergence (price lower low + MACD higher low) and hidden bearish divergence (price higher high + MACD lower high) with RSI confirmation and ATR stop. Artifacts verified on disk.

next_actions.action: HUMAN ACTION: Run WFA locally — cd 'walk forward engine' && .venv\Scripts\python.exe scripts/walk_forward_smoke_test.py --config strategies/macd_divergence/wfa_config.yaml
next_actions.rationale: The strategy is ready. Only human can execute WFA because WSL lacks pandas/numpy.

next_actions.action: If WFA produces < 20 trades across all folds, reduce div_lookback from 20-30 to 10-15 and test on 4h timeframe instead of 1h
next_actions.rationale: Shorter lookback finds more frequent pivots; 4h timeframe has more pronounced swings for divergence detection. Prevents repeating the 2-trade failure from London Sweep/ATR Breakout.

next_actions.action: Consider pinning 6-8 parameters to defaults and optimizing only 2-3 key ones (div_lookback + rsi_oversold/overbought) to reduce search space
next_actions.rationale: 100 Optuna trials in 10-D space is insufficient. Reducing to 2-3 free parameters gives the optimizer enough samples per dimension to find signal.

next_actions.action: Resolve WSL/pandas environment gap permanently — install pandas/numpy in WSL Python or restructure the orchestrator to invoke Windows .venv directly
next_actions.rationale: This blocker has now wasted 4 experiments. A permanent fix would allow the factory to be fully autonomous.

risk_notes.risk: Divergence signals may be too rare on 1h BTC to produce statistically meaningful trade counts
risk_notes.impact: Same failure mode as London Sweep (2 trades) and ATR Breakout (2 trades): zero or near-zero trades make optimization meaningless and WFR incalculable.
risk_notes.mitigation: Monitor trade count in first WFA run. If < 20 trades, immediately fall back to 4h timeframe or reduce div_lookback to 10.

risk_notes.risk: 10-parameter Optuna grid with 100 trials is high-dimensional for a new signal class
risk_notes.impact: Sparse exploration means Optuna may never find the parameter sweet spot. Sharpe IS may be noise rather than genuine signal.
risk_notes.mitigation: Pin MACD params to defaults (12/26/9) and RSI period to 14, optimize only div_lookback, rsi_oversold, rsi_overbought (3 free params).

risk_notes.risk: Recurring WSL/pandas blocker prevents the factory from generating scored evidence
risk_notes.impact: Every sophisticated strategy (Volume Profile, RSI+Polymarket, Volatility Regime, MACD Divergence) is blocked at execution. The factory can only produce evidence for simple strategies that run via wfa_minimal.py.
risk_notes.mitigation: Infrastructure fix needed: install pandas in WSL Python3 environment, or restructure orchestrator to spawn Windows .venv as subprocess for WFA runs.
